references.text: Boils and inflammation that struck the Egyptians, a similar plague God warns Israel about in Deuteronomy
Earlier in the same chapter, Egypt's boils are mentioned as a curse, which is further elaborated in verse 35
Job was struck with painful boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head, the same expression and plague described here
Isaiah describes Israel's condition with sores and boils from the sole of the foot to the head, echoing the curse in Deuteronomy
God promises not to bring Egypt's diseases upon Israel if they keep His commands, the opposite of the curse in this verse
A promise that God will keep all of Egypt's evil diseases away from Israel, contrasting with the curse here
